i1.title: Davidoff Cool Water Wave Eau de Toilette 40ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
A bright, salty splash of Cool Water for summer.

Davidoff Cool Water Wave Eau de Toilette 40ml is the 2017 edition of Davidoff's Cool Water Wave, an aquatic woody fragrance for men. Sea notes, grapefruit and Sichuan pepper open fresh and tingling, a heart of juniper and birch leaf adds a green, aromatic breeze, and it dries down to smooth sandalwood and patchouli.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Sea Notes, Grapefruit, Sichuan Pepper
  • Heart: Juniper, Birch Leaf
  • Base: Sandalwood, Patchouli

Key details

  • Brand: Davidoff
  • Concentration: Eau de Toilette
  • Size: 40ml
  • Scent profile: Aquatic · Woody · Fresh
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A fresh sea-spray and grapefruit opening
  • A crisp juniper and birch leaf heart
  • A smooth sandalwood and patchouli base
  • Handy 40ml Eau de Toilette

FAQ

What does Cool Water Wave smell like?

Sea notes, grapefruit and sichuan pepper first, then juniper and birch leaf, finishing with sandalwood and patchouli.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.

seo.title: Davidoff Cool Water Wave Eau de Toilette 40ml
seo.description: Davidoff Cool Water Wave Eau de Toilette 40ml: sea notes and grapefruit over juniper and sandalwood. Free UK delivery over £40.
